wholeProduct.summary: TradeScout remains one governed multi-app operating environment. D7 makes the active Scout conversation the primary work surface without claiming every app interior is complete.

deliverables.outcome: The authenticated OS shell, Scout and Community task loop, Businesses, Jobs, Direct Connect, and stable mobile taskbar are released and protected.

Opening or resuming a Scout task immediately presents one continuous operating workspace: compact task identity and controls, latest state and one validated next action, the real conversation and result record visibly occupying the center, and exactly one composer above the stable bottom taskbar.
deliverables.entry: Open or resume an authenticated saved Scout task in Escambia County with a representative conversation.
deliverables.ending: Read and continue the visible task record, save it, start a new task, reopen the saved task, follow its existing Community action, and return with the same title, updates, next action, county, visible record, and composer intact.
journeySteps: Open a sparse or eight-update Scout task and see the conversation work region visible without first expanding a collapsed history row.
Use a bounded internal work-region scroll that lands on the latest meaningful turn while the task header and single composer preserve orientation.
Save the task, start New, reopen it through Conversations, and recover the same task identity, updates, validated next action, county context, visible record, and composer.
Open local Community through the existing Scout next action and return to the same Scout task state.
Use the same flow at 1440 by 1000 and 390 by 844 without page-level horizontal overflow, fixed-control overlap, or a nested full-page scroll trap.

At ultra-short mobile and embedded boundaries, scroll the single outer task owner through task, auxiliary context, work record, thread, and final controls while the fixed dock and page root remain stationary.

proof.procedure: Inspect the released D2 authenticated Scout captures for the same eight-update saved flooring task at 1440x1000 and 390x844.
proof.expected: The active task record is visible as the primary work object and uses the available center between task status and composer.
proof.observed: Conversation history is collapsed by default; more than half of the desktop and a material portion of the mobile work area is inert even though eight updates exist.

proof.procedure: Trace the active-task markup, scroll behavior, saved-task handlers, Community action, fixed composer, D6 taskbar, and current focused tests at baseline cd3623ab1bf39502b4ad2133c90d6a5f60788ed6.
proof.expected: Existing canonical owners can expose a bounded central work record and preserve resume and Community continuity without a new component, route, API, or persistence owner.
proof.observed: ScoutOS already owns task identity, controls, latest state, dominant action, saved-task lifecycle, Community navigation, and composer; ScoutThread owns the bounded message record and scroll-to-latest behavior; index.css owns work-region geometry; existing focused tests own framing and thread behavior.

proof.procedure: Refresh the Selective Intelligence project index at exact baseline cd3623ab1bf39502b4ad2133c90d6a5f60788ed6.
proof.expected: Canonical Scout owners are discoverable and no competing active owner requires a new implementation.
proof.observed: The index refreshed with canonical client/src Scout owners usable. Its 1,104 errors are the pre-existing mirrored exports/workspaces duplicate baseline and remain outside D7.

proof.procedure: Run the current four-file P2 focused Scout framing/thread suite, required nine-file D7/D6/Community candidate suite, TypeScript check, source guards, and diff check.
proof.expected: All D7/P2 ownership, reachability, fixed-dock, action, taskbar, and Community assertions pass; any unrelated baseline remains explicitly isolated.
proof.observed: Focused 38/39 and required nine-file 89/90 passed except for the same unchanged HomeID initialHomeIdFromUrl source-name baseline. TypeScript, all P2 guards, and diff check passed.

proof.procedure: Exercise the authenticated adversarial saved task at 390x320/360/361, 568x320, 767x421, 768x320/360/361, and 1440x480/481, including keyboard focus, owner endpoints, ordinary wheel movement, and two distinct wheel gestures from an ended nested thread.
proof.expected: Exactly one task/aux/work/thread/composer chain remains reachable above the fixed dock, the intended outer owner moves, and body/root remain locked.
proof.observed: All measured primary, work, thread, and final-control rectangles strictly cleared the dock. Mobile used the workbench owner; short desktop used the active-column owner and returned to the normal workbench at 481px. A second distinct wheel gesture chained thread-to-column while rapid same-gesture deltas remained browser-latched and non-persistent.

constraints: Make the real conversation and result record the primary center work object; do not satisfy D7 by merely adding open to the existing details element or stretching a decorative panel.
Keep a compact task identity, existing task controls, latest meaningful state, and exactly one validated dominant next action above the work record.
Keep exactly one composer after a thread starts, fixed above the stable bottom taskbar and safe area.
Keep the first-use Scout entry inline before a thread starts.
Use existing Scout message, result, controller, saved-thread, action-validation, route, county, and persistence authorities; add no new API, schema, route, storage, or data owner.
Preserve Save, New, Conversations, delete, and saved-task restore behavior.
Preserve the D6 fixed bottom taskbar, most-specific active routing, and top-right account and system owner.
Preserve Community feed-first presentation, all five start routes, global browse-only behavior, and the existing Scout-to-Community action.
Preserve visibility-not-access, county boundaries, Trust/CVS, and Intent to Decision Card to Contact gating.
Reuse canonical client/src owners and extend existing focused tests; create no parallel Scout component, shell, taskbar, route registry, or test owner.
Do not edit exports/workspaces mirrors, JW Stone lanes, backend code, or unrelated app interiors.
Do not copy Windows branding or literal window chrome; express the operating-environment model through persistent work, orientation, and recovery.
Do not describe this bounded deliverable as whole-product completion.
excludedFromActive: Broad Community redesign or new Community interaction model.
Changes to Businesses, Jobs, Direct Connect, Share, Exchange, HomeID, Messages, or other app interiors.
Shell, taskbar, top-right menu, route, API, backend, schema, migration, persistence, authentication, role, county, contact, Trust/CVS, or production-data changes.
Repository-wide duplicate cleanup in mirrored exports/workspaces trees.
Literal Windows branding, floating windows, or a new desktop/window manager.
proofRequired: Focused existing Scout framing and thread behavior tests proving the visible work region, a single composer and dominant action, bounded scrolling, latest-turn behavior, sparse history, saved-task restore, and Community return without weakening action validation.
Focused D6 taskbar and Community browse-only regression tests.
Typecheck and production build at the exact implementation commit.

Authenticated rendered proof at 1440x1000, 1440x600, 390x844, both sides of the 730/731px short-desktop boundary, and the P2 390x320/360/361, 568x320, 767x421, 768x320/360/361, and 1440x480/481 boundaries for sparse, eight-update, adversarial, and long-history tasks, including geometry, full work/thread containment, intentional nested-to-outer wheel chaining, taskbar and composer clearance, top-right tools, and zero page-level overflow.
Rendered Save to New to Conversations to reopen proof plus Scout to Community to Scout return proof using the same county and saved task.
Exact minimum-release gate and post-deploy x-tradescout-build plus /api/health identity before a release completion claim.

completionClaims.claim: The active Scout conversation and result record visibly occupies the primary center work region instead of remaining hidden behind a collapsed history row.
Sparse and long task records remain usable in a bounded internal work region that reaches the latest turn without creating page-level scroll or fixed-control overlap.
Save, New, Conversations, and reopen restore the same task identity, record, action, county, and composer.
The existing local Community action and return preserve the active Scout task while Community remains feed-first and globally browse-only.
The released shell, action authority, routes, APIs, roles, counties, contact gates, Trust/CVS, and other app interiors remain protected.

deliverables.outcome: Observe and correct the next concrete Community interior defect without reopening the stable shell or the D7 Scout workspace.

executionTarget.rationale: The canonical TradeScout repository already owns the authenticated Scout controller, saved conversations, action validation, Community handoff, shell, responsive styles, tests, and production release identity required for D7.
constraintsConsidered: The result depends on authenticated saved-task state, existing controller messages and actions, county continuity, shell offsets, and production routing.
A standalone site, component preview, or new window manager cannot prove the governed task-resume loop.
